schema.id:
Xfini Academy – Student Attendance & Professional Conduct Policy
Attendance Policy
Students are required to attend all online classes regularly and punctually. Continuous absence for 3 consecutive days without prior communication or approval will result in: Removal from the official student group Revocation of app/platform access Repeated irregular attendance or frequent class skipping may also lead to suspension or revocation of access. Attendance will be monitored automatically through the Zoom attendance system.
Professional Participation Guidelines
Students are expected to attend classes professionally and actively participate during sessions. Cameras should remain ON during classes unless a valid reason has been communicated in advance. Students temporarily unavailable (e.g., getting ready for work) must rejoin properly and inform faculty if necessary. By approximately 7:00 PM – 7:15 PM, students are expected to be fully attentive and actively participating.
Classroom Conduct Rules
Attending classes while driving is strictly prohibited due to safety concerns. Attending classes from bed or in an unprofessional manner is not acceptable. Students must maintain a respectful and professional learning environment at all times. Respect towards faculty, classmates, and the programme is mandatory.
Communication & Support
Students facing genuine issues affecting attendance or participation must inform the academy in advance. Appropriate support may be considered only when prior communication is provided.
Academy Expectations
These policies are implemented to maintain:
Discipline Professionalism Commitment to learning Better academic outcomes 
Negligence towards learning responsibilities will not be encouraged or accepted.
